CONDITIONAL: CONDITIONAL. Sprint 24's own diff (9d5af65) meets every requirement R1-R9 and
is the cleanest work I've audited on this project. It is blocked by a broken
repo state it did not create.

BLOCKING CONDITION (not sprint 24's code):
`npm run lint` fails with 25 errors, all @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports,
all in scripts/install.js and scripts/launcher/*.js. Those files are new in the
PRECEDING commit e14d633 ("Tooling housekeeping"), not in 9d5af65. Verified:
`npx eslint app lib` is completely clean, and none of those paths existed at
db915b8. .github/workflows/ci.yml line 22 runs `npm run lint` as its FIRST step,
so pushing this sprint puts CI red on the very first job and LiveQA gets
nothing deployable to test. The sprint's own acceptance criteria require lint
clean; it is not clean, so I cannot record a PASS.
Fix belongs to tooling, not to this sprint: add "scripts/**" to globalIgnores in
eslint.config.mjs (same rationale as the existing "docs/design/**" ignore -- Node
CJS launcher scripts are not app source), or convert the launchers to ESM. Per
CLAUDE.md's "Changes to this repo's own tooling" that is not sprint work, but it
must land and be committed before sprint 24 ships. Re-run /sprint-qa1 24 once
lint is green; I will re-audit against the new HEAD.

REQUIREMENTS COVERAGE -- all met:
R1 met. "Cast"->"Cast the chart", "Save this reading"->"See the full reading",
"Read the chart"->"Write the horoscope". Greps for the old labels return only
explanatory comments, nothing user-facing. No digits in any of the three labels.
R2 met. Four states reachable, driven by one `completedSteps` 0-3 number.
/chart uses `positions ? 1 : 0`, /reading uses `horoscope ? 3 : 2`. Not
hardcoded per route -- this was the sprint's headline risk and it was handled
correctly.
R3 met, and this is the one I checked hardest. No "use client" added or removed
anywhere in the diff. No useState/useEffect/useRef introduced (the only grep
hits are the word "useState" inside a doc comment). app/chart/page.tsx still
opens with `import`, still a server component. FlowIndicator is a pure function
of its single prop.
R4 met. One module, app/components/FlowIndicator.tsx, imported by both routes.
No duplication.
R5 met. app/layout.tsx untouched by the commit.
R6 met. "not read yet" gone from both sites (ReadingPanel.tsx:70 and
page.tsx:392). IdleBlock accent now reads "write the horoscope", matching the
button. "Cast a new reading" -> "Cast a new chart" with the reasoning written
into the comment at ReadingPanel.tsx:128 -- the deliberate decision R6 asked to
see, not left ambiguous.
R7 met. Commit touches no file under lib/llm/ and not app/chart/actions.ts.
"Try again", "Copy link"/"Copied" intact.
R8 met. package.json untouched, globals.css untouched (still 20 --om- tokens).
flow-indicator.module.css defines zero new custom properties and consumes only
--om-bone, --om-bone-dim, --om-grey-dim, --om-ink, --om-rule-strong,
--om-verdigris, --font-mono -- every one verified to already exist
(--font-mono via next/font in layout.tsx:20).
R9 plausible statically. flex-wrap + flexible connector (flex 1 1 20px,
min 12px, max 44px) instead of a fixed layout, and the mobile block correctly
adds flex-shrink: 0 to .flowSlot, matching what Sprint 20 needed for .dateBand
in the same fixed-height flex column. Real proof is LiveQA's.

CODE QUALITY:
Tests: adequate and honestly scoped. stepState() extracted as a pure function
and unit tested across all four states, with the reasoning for testing it
directly (no React rendering setup in this project) written down rather than
silently skipped. 188/188 pass. I'd rather see this than a fake render test.
Error handling: nothing new introduced, nothing swallowed. Correct for a diff
that is presentational by design.
Standards: comments explain WHY and cite requirement numbers. The chart.module.css
comment referring to the old labels was updated rather than left to rot -- that
is the kind of thing that usually gets missed.
Security: no new user input, no new interpolation, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
Sprint 18/19 guarantees intact -- escaped horoscope rendering, no markdown
library, isSafeExternalUrl still on event URLs, fonts still via next/font.
Build clean.

NON-BLOCKING ISSUE (fix it while you're in there, don't make a sprint of it):
[low] app/components/FlowIndicator.tsx:60,64 -- `styles[state]` renders the
literal string "undefined" as a class name when state === "ahead". The CSS
module defines .marker.done/.current and .label.done/.current but no .ahead, so
styles.ahead is undefined and the DOM gets class="..._marker__hash undefined" on
every ahead step -- which is both steps on a cold /chart. Visually correct,
because the base .marker/.label already carry the ahead appearance, so nothing
looks wrong. It is still shipping garbage into the markup. Either define an
empty .ahead in the module or fall back with `styles[state] ?? ""`.

Scope discipline: the sprint declared .claude/, scripts/, and CLAUDE.md out of
scope and 9d5af65 touches none of them. Correct. The lint breakage arrived on
the adjacent housekeeping commit, which is exactly the risk this sprint's own
Dependencies section flagged -- settle the tooling tree before building app code
on it. It got committed, but committed red is not settled.
